record.question: Pharmacy council of India (PCI) was established in the year:
record.explanation: Official final key: B — 1948. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 9, printed Q56. The final key chooses 1948, the Pharmacy Act year. PCI itself states that the Council was constituted on 9 August 1949, which is absent from the printed choices. Reference: https://pci.gov.in/en/about-us/ . Keep this factual distinction visible.
